title: Extension properties for partial permutations
summary: Motivated by the EPPA problem for finite tournaments,we consider various extension properties for partial permutations. We show that for any set $Π$ of prime numbers, the $Π$-extension property is equivalent to the $Π$-LERF. As a consequence of known results, the odd-extension property is then equivalent to the EPPA for finite tournaments. To study the $Π$-extension property, we reformate the property using the concepts of EP problems and $Π$-solutions.
